calibration: Before freezing, code was tested on unit fixtures and old G8 training tasks. New validation and continuation holdout outcomes have not been used to tune it.
claim_boundary: bounded search-policy evolution; no new primitive, external model training, internet study or arbitrary host-source rewrite
continuation_gate: engine admission then three native program admissions, previous-program reuse, heldout and old-skill regression
fresh_gate: one frozen policy; all 3 validation tasks train and holdout correct; no retries on reserved inputs
policy_selection: one candidate derived solely from active gene IR; operator frequency ranking and bounded reviewed mutation rules
training_gate: all prior admitted tasks solved from their pre-admission memory; strictly fewer expression evaluations in aggregate
